# Hash- and version-locked dependencies for MindEd (AA-OS) scientific reproducibility.
# Complete transitive closure (pip --require-hashes compatible); hashes cover every
# published distribution of each pinned version, so the lock is platform independent.
# Refresh hashes with: python scripts/regenerate_lock.py --rehash requirements-lock.txt (see its docstring to add a package).
# lifelines (+ matplotlib, formulaic, autograd closure) is locked because the release gate runs the
# lifelines cross-validation test (tests/test_phase28_survival_hardening.py) with max_skips=0.
# It is resolved against the pins above, so no pre-existing pin moved.
